Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.window

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen.window
Native desktop windows, hosted screen navigation, and two-context presentation.

To open a local screen from an addon, start with OffscreenAPI. Keep the returned Window reference for later title, size, navigation, and close operations.

Minecraft's primary graphics context draws each GUI into a shared texture. The owning desktop window's context attaches that texture to its own framebuffer and presents it after a GPU synchronization fence. Every context switch must also select the matching LWJGL capabilities and optional shader-context tag. Lifecycle work stays on the client thread and releases resources in their owning contexts before those contexts are destroyed.
